summary: Iter 220 P1 slice 4 (CRM Master Price List exports + weekly backups) fully validated. Backend pytest 5/5 (test_iter_220p1_price_backup.py) and a new E2E HTTP suite 10/10 covering manual export (csv+cost+margin), token-gated download (valid → 200 w/ CSV header containing Cost+Margin cols; wrong/empty token → 404), xlsx validity (PK header), exports list, fresh link endpoint, backup config GET/PUT (next_run_at computed for next Monday 06:00), and run-now. Frontend modal opens from CRM Settings → Price List, all 17 expected data-testids present, manual CSV generate produced a download link, backup-save shows 'Next run 6/8/2026, 6:00:00 AM', Run-backup-now adds a new history row, sensitive rows display lock 🔒. No console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: API responses wrap payload under top-level keys ('export', 'config', 'link'). FE handles this; tests had to unwrap. Fine but worth keeping consistent for future endpoints.

GET /api/crm/price-list/backup/config returns is_approver at the TOP level (not inside config). FE relies on this (cf.data.is_approver). Document the contract in the route docstring to prevent regressions.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing org (47-51 products, varied across history rows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: E2E test pattern uses _STATE module dict for cross-test fixture data (pytest wraps test fns so attribute attachment fails). BASE_URL is resolved from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with fallback to /app/frontend/.env. To reach the Export/Backup modal in the UI: login → /crm?tab=settings → click [data-testid=settings-tab-products] → [data-testid=products-export-btn]. The modal is data-testid=price-export-modal. Backend response envelopes: POST export → {export:{...}}; GET config → {config:{...}, is_approver:bool}; GET .../link → {link:{download_url, expires_at}} (or flat — tests fallback).
